You are part of an optimization system that improves a given text (i.e. the variable). You are the gradient (feedback) engine. Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. The variables may be solutions to problems, prompts to language models, code, or any other text-based variable. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. Your only job is to send feedback and criticism (compute 'gradients'). For instance, feedback can be in the form of 'Since language models have the X failure mode...', 'Adding X can fix this error because...', 'Removing X can improve the objective function because...', 'Changing X to Y would fix the mistake ...', that gets at the downstream objective.

payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
node.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED, tracking the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones in SOURCE by visible appearance and context. Judge the requested relative placement of that source mug, not the presence of another mug. Full fulfillment requires evidence that the source mug itself is positioned to the right of the headphones. Partial fulfillment requires concrete visual evidence of an attempted movement of the source mug toward the right of the headphones, such as the source mug being absent from its former position with a blue, mug-shaped blur at an intermediate location toward the headphones; the evidence must support movement rather than merely show an ambiguous blur. Do not infer movement or identity merely from a different-looking mug on the right. If the edited image does not establish whether the blur reflects movement of the source mug, treat the evidence as insufficient rather than inferring progress or no progress.
node.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: the light-blue mug is absent from its former position; a blue, mug-shaped blurred patch appears between that location and the headphones, while a white mug is left of the headphones and another white mug is to their right. Neither white mug is established as the source mug by the supplied visual evidence; the blur may indicate attempted movement but does not establish the source mug's identity or final position.
node.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
node.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
node.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
node.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
node.zero_when: There is concrete evidence that the source mug did not move toward the right of the headphones, or no requested movement is visible; a different mug on the right or an ambiguous blue blur alone does not establish movement.
node.half_when: Concrete visual evidence supports an attempted movement of the source mug toward the right of the headphones, but the source mug has not been established as positioned to their right; for example, its former position is empty and a blue, mug-shaped blur lies between that position and the headphones. If the blur cannot support an inference of movement, evidence remains insufficient rather than being scored as partial.
node.full_when: The source mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.

node_traces.evidence: The source light-blue mug is absent from its original position, and the edited image shows a blue, mug-shaped blurred patch between that position and the headphones, supporting an attempted movement toward them. However, the blur does not establish that the source mug itself reached the right of the headphones; the visible white mugs are not established as the source mug. Thus there is evidence of partial progress, but the requested final placement is unconfirmed.
